gen-gf-underdog-fs-public-sans: Horseshoe curves, no swell anywhere: that's Underdog, loud and commanding up top. Public Sans has a hefty lowercase and broad counters, so give it a generous size and let it breathe.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anuphan: Unica One has huge lowercase eyes and one constant line width. It grabs attention with that rigid line, while Anuphan's big round bowls and open curves do the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-gafata: Commanding from the first glance, Unica One has huge lowercase eyes and strokes that never change thickness. Unica One is made to announce; Gafata is made for steady text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-geist: Distinctive, Unica One shows daylight inside every curve. Geist, a sans-serif with a quiet, level beat, lays words down as solid blocks rather than skylines, line after line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-gidole: Huge lowercase eyes, with daylight inside every curve, give Unica One its commanding look. Gidole, a sans-serif with scissor-open terminals and neon-tube consistency, is the one built to hold quieter text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Ruler-straight and loud, Unica One keeps a constant line width around its huge lowercase eyes. And Hedvig Letters Sans, with its wide c gap and near-capital small letters, makes the pair feel approachable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-madurai: Unica One draws huge lowercase eyes with visible daylight in every curve, all at one constant line width. Hind Madurai fills the line like capitals, giving the pair real presence.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-siliguri: Huge eyes, single-width strokes: Unica One means it. Hind Siliguri hums along with a flat gray constant weight and a gentle bump up to capitals, so the loud heading has a steady partner.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-inter-tight: Big eyes, constant strokes, plenty of daylight: Unica One is hard to ignore. Inter Tight, with short ascenders and tucked-back curve tails, is worth giving a slightly larger size so the tight lowercase stays comfortable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-kufam: Huge lowercase eyes and daylight inside every curve give Unica One its commanding, distinctive face. But Kufam's neon-tube strokes and open e curves dominate the line, so a modest size is enough.
